title: The Big Sick
about: A Pakistani-American comic falls for a grad student who falls seriously ill, and gets to know her parents at the hospital.
cue: Serve the mains when Kumail's mum sits him down to family dinner with yet another surprise guest.
faces: Open 6 pm till 2 am on weekends.
+ Surprise dinner guests, set up as possible brides
+ Emily's cheerful heckle at a comedy show
+ The long wait in the hospital
Kumail Nanjiani, 5 minutes. Chicago comedy club.
My mother keeps inviting a woman to dinner. I keep not mentioning that I'm seeing someone else.
